fee_notes: The standard Initial Franchise Fee is $19,950 for the first territory, paid when signing the franchise agreement. A 15% discount applies for currently-serving or honorably discharged veterans of the U.S. armed forces and their spouses, reducing the fee to $16,957.50. There is no Initial Franchise Fee payable under a subsequent franchise agreement. Note: A separate Initial Territory Fee of $40,000 (or $37,400 for veterans) is also required for the first territory when purchasing directly from the franchisor, but this is a distinct fee from the Initial Franchise Fee.
raw_excerpt: You will pay us an Initial Franchise Fee of $19,950 when you sign the franchise agreement for your first territory. We discount the Initial Franchise Fee by 15% for new franchisees who are currently-serving or honorably discharged veterans of the United States armed forces and their spouses. If you are a veteran, active service member or spouse of a veteran or active service member of the United States armed forces, you will therefore pay a discounted Initial Franchise Fee of $16,957.50. There is no Initial Franchise Fee payable under a subsequent franchise agreement.
